name: Monash University
description: Monash University is a public research university founded in 1958, with its main campuses in Melbourne. It is a member of the Group of Eight and is Australia's largest university by enrolment, with faculties spanning medicine, engineering, business, law and the arts.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and a Group of Eight university on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) (Legal Profession (Qualified Persons) Rules) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: Monash's own estimate for a shared rental near Clayton, utilities, food, transport, phone and entertainment for 12 months, using the middle of its ranges.
livingCosts.notes: Monash 'Cost of living' page (no year given; 2026 is the year it was read), weekly range midpoints x 52/12. Housing: shared rental in the Clayton area $275-$380/wk + gas, water and electricity $40-$80/wk. Food: groceries and eating out $150-$500/wk. Transport: public transport $25-$50/wk. Personal: phone and internet $20-$46/wk + entertainment $150-$300/wk. Other columns: on campus $350-$450/wk, homestay $275-$430/wk, private rental $500-$750/wk. Monash's headline is A$30,000-$45,000 per year. monash.edu blocks automated access (Cloudflare challenge); the page was read on 2026-09-30 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of the official URL.
